canonical_project: Dhuvaran Cable Landing Station and Data Connectivity Project
owner: Henox IT & Datacenters Private Limited / Government of Gujarat / GIFT City
notes: Reported Rs 1,317 crore MoU for a cable landing station in Dhuvaran, Anand district, with onward connectivity to GIFT City. Included as data-centre-adjacent digital infrastructure; no server-hall MW capacity disclosed.
